purpose: A move rebased onto a history in which the source file had been deleted.

pairs.note: the rebased commit is an addition with no deletion: the source is not in the window, so no window-local method can recover this and silence is the only right answer

notes: This fixture bounds the recall number. Scoring every true pair as reachable would be measuring the fixtures rather than the methods, and a 100 % bar nobody can reach is a bar that gets quietly dropped later.
